reviews.text:
I can’t say enough great things about this pool company! They have been incredibly professional, dependable, and proactive from day one. Their communication is excellent—they always keep me informed and make everything stress-free.
I originally hired them when I couldn’t maintain my pool due to a shoulder injury, and even after recovering, I chose to keep their service because they’re just that good. They handle weekly maintenance flawlessly, and I’ve also used them for cleaning my salt cell and filters—every time, the work is thorough and top-notch.
If you’re looking for a company that truly cares about your pool and provides exceptional service, I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Chris Loy

reviews.text: Hydrotex Pool is a great pool company! I always have Ron and every week he always shows up at the same time, same day, with great effort and hard work. Ron even checks in when I’m outside on occasion and asks if I need anything else done with the pool. He’s always kind and courteous! Very friendly, too. He does a great job with my pool! Aside from that, Hydrotex always meets me and my families needs when we have a small issue with our pool. They immediately come out when we have an overflow of rain water. They are very prompt to get back to me. Thank you guys!
reviews.author: Lisa Humphrey

reviews.text: We just can't say enough about Hydrotex Pools and especially about Chance, their fantastic expert who helped us with a severe algae issue with our pool. It was awful and we thought we were going to have a MUCH bigger problem. Chance was amazing and got us back to normal within just a few days, without draining the pool. He was here every day monitoring and managing the issue. We are so thankful for all of it. Additionally, communication to us was outstanding, ever step of the way. We are about to schedule Hydrotex for weekly service through fall and winter (and maybe spring and summer) because we were so impressed with the ease, service results, and pricing. Thanks for everything Hydrotex. Call them TODAY if you need help or service on your pool. Thanks guys and special thanks to Chance.

reviews.text: My pool overflowed last month with all the heavy rain. It went from being crystal clear to looking like a swamp. A technician came out each day to backwash it, add clarifier, clean the filters and finally vacuum it. The technicians explained everything they were doing and why, both verbally and in email. My pool now looks amazing again!
reviews.author: Deb Passwaters

reviews.text: Hydrotexpools did an amazing job with our pool! Communication was great, pricing fair, and we have a sparkling pool that we can finally enjoy. They were very thorough and answered all my questions. Highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Adriana Dameron

reviews.text:

Ryan

reviews.text:
We have used a lot of Pool Services companies over the last 25+ years and can say confidently that Hydrotex Pools is by far the best we’ve ever had.

Hydrotex is extremely knowledgeable and responsive and provide great diagnostic summaries via email whenever they service the pool, including chemical balances and photos. The quality of their work is always outstanding and their communication is excellent.

Thanks for the great service, Hydotex!
